# SquashHub

> The all-in-one club management platform for squash — court bookings, ladders, championships, member management, automated court lighting and access control.

SquashHub helps squash clubs, leagues and associations run their operations from a single affordable platform. Clubs get their own branded subdomain, members book courts and join ladders from any device, and admins manage fixtures, fees and communications without spreadsheets.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Squash club management software overview and key features.
- [Clubs](/clubs): Find and explore squash clubs using SquashHub.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming club events and tournaments.
- [Tournaments](/tournaments): Club championships and tournament listings.
- [Lights & Access](/lights): Automated court lighting and access control solutions for clubs.
- [League Signup](/league): League player self-registration for association-run leagues.
- [Terms](/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Service Level Agreement](/sla): Support and uptime commitments.

## Optional
